newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs edge down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs edge down in slow trade.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts closed easier in subdued trading Monday, in line with losses in local markets earlier, traders said.
They said profit taking drove shares down early in the day before late buying allowed GDRs to settle at a slight loss from Friday.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.51 points down at 87.48, with the premium over the local market at 27.71 percent from 28.13 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index closed lower 4.58 points, or 0.11 percent, at 4,025.41.
The market's tone remains positive despite the day's loss.
"This market has got 4,300 written all over it," a trader said.
Demand was from a mix on international buyers, traders said.
Telco shed 47 cents to $14.50/$15.25 and Reliance gained 32 cents to $21.60/$22.60.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed down 1.36 points, or 1.69 percent, to 79.13 points, a premium of 44.74 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 3.95 points, or 3.23 percent, to 126.40, representing a discount to the local market of 2.19 percent.
